Autosave runs every 5 minutes while a city is open, including when paused. A closed browser cannot run the game. Saves are checked after writing.

Your first city

  1. Connect the roads. Extend the starter road by clicking and dragging. Your road network must reach the map edge. Use Show outside connection in the city overview.
  2. Bring in utilities. Place a power station and a water tower beside connected roads.
  3. Zone a neighborhood. Paint residential zones beside roads, then retail and industry for jobs.
  4. Meet their needs. Add parks, education, healthcare, police, fire protection and waste services as your city grows.
  5. Keep a balanced budget. Check your daily income and adjust taxes in Economy.

Residents & households

Every resident has a saved home and routine. Residents walk along connected paths and sidewalks, ride buses, or drive. Blocked journeys wait for access. Locate shows their current position.
